knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 2.6.4
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. For iid Normal samples (CMP): (1) What is the distribution of X̄? (2) What sampling result applies to the sample variance (χ² form as CMP)? (3) Why is this not yet the t-statistic LO?
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: For Normal samples, X̄ is Normal with mean μ and variance σ²/n (CMP). Sample variance follows a χ²-related law as CMP states. The t-statistic is a separate LO when σ is replaced by S.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.
